data.title: Callback Number Mismatch for Claimed Institution
data.description: Detects when an inbound caller claims to represent a specific financial institution or internal department, but the originating ANI or callback number does not match the institution's known directory of outbound numbers. This is a common indicator of vishing and social engineering, especially when combined with voice-clone technology to impersonate bank officials.

enrichment_required.source: Phone directory lookup enrichment (ANI verification against known numbers)
Phone directory lookup enrichment (callback number verification)

falsepositives: Legitimate bank employee calling from a personal device during off-hours
Third-party call center using non-registered outbound numbers
Recent phone system migration with directory not yet updated
